[[Category:Operating Systems]]
Regard system as a set of processes and resources

Examples of resoures - devices, cpu cycles, semaphores, mutex locks, shared memory


Assume processes use resources in 3 steps

# Request
# Use
# Release

==Deadlocks==
Deadlocks occur when something cannot happen because there's an impossible paradox of things waiting

[[File:Resource allocation graph.png|thumb|Resource allocation graph]]
Resource allocation graphs

==Dealing with deadlock==

Three methods

# Ensure system never enters deadlock
# allow deadlock and then let the system recover
# Do nothing

3rd is the most common

==Deadlock prevention==

* Mutex exclusion, make resources shareable
* Hold and wait, force processes to request every resource they need simultaneously
* No preemption:

Circular wait: apply some enumeration to all resources: r1, r2, r3, ......, rm
===Additional note===
Each process needs to declare the amount of resources it needs beforehand[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
